title: SentinelLLM incident record
description: One incident = one correlated group of events = one row in the ML feature table.

label.description: Ground truth. Synthetic data: known by construction. Real data: requires a documented labelling protocol.

scenario_family.description: GROUPING KEY for train/test splits. Never split within a family - near-duplicate incidents leak (guide 14).

is_hard_negative.description: Benign activity that superficially resembles the attack (signed updater in Temp, real CAPTCHA, dev toolchain). These drive the false-positive rate that matters.

ground_truth_stages.description: Stage-level ground truth: scores attack-chain reconstruction, not just binary detection.

intel_version.description: abuse.ch reputation index version whose indicators grounded this synthetic incident (intel/build_index.py). Absent for pre-intel data.
